title.en: IBM Deep Blue defeats world chess champion Garry Kasparov
title.zhHans: IBM 深蓝击败国际象棋世界冠军 Garry Kasparov

summary.en: On May 11, 1997, IBM's Deep Blue supercomputer defeated world chess champion Garry Kasparov 3½–2½ in a six-game rematch in New York City. It was the first time a computer beat a reigning world champion under standard tournament conditions. The match became a global media event and marked the moment when the public began to see AI as a credible rival to human intellect.
summary.zhHans: 1997 年 5 月 11 日，IBM 的深蓝超级计算机在纽约的六局重赛中以 3½–2½ 击败了国际象棋世界冠军 Garry Kasparov。这是计算机首次在标准锦标赛条件下击败卫冕世界冠军。这场对决成为全球媒体事件，标志着公众开始将 AI 视为人类智力的可信对手。

narrative.en: The first match between Kasparov and Deep Blue took place in Philadelphia in February 1996. Kasparov won 4–2. The IBM team, led by Feng-hsiung Hsu, Murray Campbell, and Joseph Hoane, spent the next year upgrading Deep Blue—adding specialized VLSI chess chips that could evaluate 200 million positions per second. The rematch was held at the Equitable Center in New York City from May 3–11, 1997. Game 1: Kasparov wins. Game 2: Deep Blue wins—a shock to the chess world. Game 3, 4, 5: all draws. Game 6: Kasparov, playing black, resigns after just 19 moves. Deep Blue wins the match 3½–2½. Kasparov was furious. He accused the IBM team of human intervention, noting that Deep Blue had made an uncharacteristic 'sacrificial' move in Game 2. IBM refused to release the logs, and Kasparov's demand for a rematch was denied. IBM retired Deep Blue shortly after, donating one rack to the Smithsonian and another to the Computer History Museum. The legacy was twofold. For AI, it proved that brute-force search combined with domain expertise could surpass the best human in a well-defined task—though at the cost of generalizability. For the public, it was the first AI 'man versus machine' spectacle that captured the world's imagination, establishing a template that would be repeated with Jeopardy in 2011, Go in 2016, and many domains beyond.
narrative.zhHans: Kasparov 与深蓝的第一场对决于 1996 年 2 月在费城举行。Kasparov 以 4–2 获胜。由许峰雄、Murray Campbell 和 Joseph Hoane 领导的 IBM 团队花了一年时间升级深蓝——添加了每秒可评估 2 亿个局面的专用 VLSI 国际象棋芯片。重赛于 1997 年 5 月 3 日至 11 日在纽约公平中心举行。第 1 局：Kasparov 获胜。第 2 局：深蓝获胜——震动国际象棋界。第 3、4、5 局：全部和棋。第 6 局：执黑的 Kasparov 仅 19 步就认输。深蓝以 3½–2½ 获胜。Kasparov 大为震怒。他指责 IBM 团队在比赛中进行了人为干预，指出深蓝在第 2 局做了一个非典型的"牺牲"走法。IBM 拒绝公布日志，Kasparov 要求重赛也被拒绝。IBM 随后退役了深蓝，将一台机架捐赠给史密森尼博物馆，另一台捐赠给计算机历史博物馆。其遗产是双重的。对 AI 而言，它证明了蛮力搜索与领域专业知识相结合可以在明确定义的任务中超越最优秀的人类——尽管以牺牲泛化能力为代价。对公众而言，这是第一个吸引全球想象力的 AI"人机对决"盛事，确立了后来在 2011 年 Jeopardy、2016 年围棋以及许多其他领域中重复使用的模板。

description.en: First computer to defeat a reigning world champion in chess under tournament conditions. Demonstrated that specialized hardware + brute-force search + expert knowledge engineering could surpass human world-class performance in a complex cognitive domain.
description.zhHans: 首台在锦标赛条件下击败卫冕国际象棋世界冠军的计算机。证明了专用硬件 + 蛮力搜索 + 专家知识工程可以在复杂的认知领域超越人类世界级表现。

description.en: Transformed public perception of AI from academic curiosity to credible rival to human intellect. The match was watched globally and became the archetype for all subsequent 'man vs. machine' narratives—from Watson on Jeopardy to AlphaGo to the modern debate about AGI timelines.
description.zhHans: 将公众对 AI 的认知从学术好奇转变为人类智力的可信对手。这场比赛被全球关注，成为所有后续"人机对决"叙事的原型——从 Watson 参加 Jeopardy 到 AlphaGo 到关于 AGI 时间线的当代辩论。

description.en: IBM's stock rose significantly after the match. The victory became a powerful marketing narrative for AI, helping justify sustained corporate investment in AI research through the late 1990s and early 2000s, bridging the gap between the second AI winter and the deep learning era.
description.zhHans: IBM 股价在赛后显著上涨。这场胜利成为 AI 的强大营销叙事，帮助证明了从 1990 年代末到 2000 年代初持续的企业 AI 研究投资的合理性，弥合了第二次 AI 冬天与深度学习时代之间的鸿沟。

text.en: On May 11, 1997, IBM's Deep Blue defeated world chess champion Garry Kasparov 3½–2½ in a six-game match in New York City.
text.zhHans: 1997 年 5 月 11 日，IBM 的深蓝在纽约的六局比赛中以 3½–2½ 击败了国际象棋世界冠军 Garry Kasparov。

text.en: The Deep Blue-Kasparov match was a global media event that fundamentally shifted public understanding of AI capabilities, establishing the 'man versus machine' narrative that persists today.
text.zhHans: 深蓝-Kasparov 对决是一个全球媒体事件，从根本上改变了公众对 AI 能力的理解，确立了延续至今的"人机对决"叙事。

sources.quote: Deep Blue prevailed in the tension-filled Game 6, thereby achieving a resounding victory, 3.5–2.5, in the rematch and becoming the first computer system to defeat a reigning world champion under standard tournament time controls.
On May 11, 1997, chess grandmaster Garry Kasparov resigns after 19 moves in a game against Deep Blue, a chess-playing computer developed by scientists at IBM.
Deep Blue defeated Garry Kasparov in May 1997.
